description:
Chun-Li's fast walk speed gives her virtually limitless ways to attack, with a collection of moves that are perfect for punishing openings in your opponent's gameplan.

Learn the character’s basic controls and moves to prepare for Street Fighter 6. Street Fighter 6 launches on June 2 on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam!
